intro: Intensity is set once per property and follows the register. The theme keeps its identity at every level; only the volume changes.

levels.name: Full
levels.stays: Everything on the card: glitch, chroma split, stutter, flicker, stepped frames, cursor effects.

levels.name: Tempered
levels.stays: Palette, type trio, transition grammar, the S1 signature, the ambient layer.
levels.goes: Glitch, chroma and stutter cut to accents of 150 ms or less, at most one per section. Saturation down 20%. No cursor effects.

levels.name: Boardroom
levels.stays: Palette (darkened or neutralized), type trio, one transition grammar, the S1 at low contrast.
levels.goes: All glitch, flicker, stutter, chroma split and stepped-frame motion; particles above 30; any WebGL fluid.

rules: Every card ends with a Boardroom translation. A theme marked 'never pitched for B2B' is never pitched for B2B work.
One chapter may step up one level for a deliberate beat, such as TX-06's flipped world or TX-10's infrared chapter. Declare it in the manifest.
The dial never loosens a hard gate. A Full build still keeps reduced-motion guards, pause controls and the flash limits.

engine.note: How the reel engine applies the dial. Values are multipliers on each pass; OFF means the pass is skipped.
